## What we offer

- **100+ shades on display** — wavy, curly, straight, and bone-straight textures
- **All grades, always in stock:**
  - Single Drawn — standard premium human hair
  - Double Drawn — thicker root-to-tip, more volume per strand
  - Premium Remy — cuticle-aligned, longest lifespan, most natural movement
  - **Indonesian-sourced human hair** — native to the region, well-suited to
    South-East Asian hair types and tropical climate (always in stock)
- **Six application methods:**
  - Keratin Bond — from IDR 3,500,000 / 100g (~ 2–4 months wear)
  - Nano Ring — from IDR 2,500,000 / 100g (~ 2 months)
  - Micro Ring — from IDR 1,900,000 / 100g (~ 2 months)
  - Weft — from IDR 1,900,000 / 100g (~ 2 months)
  - Tape-In — from IDR 2,500,000 / 100g (~ 2 months)
  - Clip-In — custom quote (reusable 6–12 months)
- **Maintenance service** — repositioning, aftercare, lifetime support on WhatsApp
- **Free WhatsApp colour match** before your visit

## What we do NOT offer

- Hair cutting / trimming

We focus on extension fitting and maintenance only. For cuts or colour, please
visit a salon you already trust.

## Common questions

### Do you offer hair styling, cuts, or colour?
No — we specialise in hair extensions only. We sell, fit, and maintain
extensions; we don't do cuts, colour, blow-dries, or any styling service.
Kami toko rambut, bukan salon. For those, please visit a salon you trust.
Come to us for world-class hair and expert installation.

### Where can I buy hair extensions in Bali?
The Hair Extensions Bali at Jl. Mertanadi No.79, Kerobokan Kelod. Open Mon–Sun
09:00–19:00. Walk in to browse 100+ shades on the wall, or message WhatsApp
+62 821-4691-8725 to book ahead.

### Is The Hair Extensions Bali a salon or a shop?
A shop. Specifically a hair extension shop — toko rambut — that also offers
installation. We don't do salon services (cuts, colour, blow-dries).
Customers buy hair off the wall and have it fitted the same day.

### Do you use real human hair?
Yes — 100% real human hair only. Grades: Single Drawn, Double Drawn, Premium
Remy, and Indonesian-sourced. All can be styled, dyed, and cared for like
your own hair.

### Do you stock Indonesian hair?
Yes, always — Indonesian-sourced human hair is permanently in stock alongside
international Remy. It's native to the region and well-suited to South-East
Asian hair types and tropical Balinese climate.

### How much do hair extensions cost in Bali?
At The Hair Extensions Bali (all prices per 100g, installation included):
- Micro Ring or Weft: from IDR 1,900,000
- Nano Ring or Tape-In: from IDR 2,500,000
- Keratin Bond: from IDR 3,500,000
- Premium Keratin Bond: up to IDR 7,000,000
- Clip-In: custom quote (no installation needed)

### How long do hair extensions last?
Wear time before repositioning, assuming no tangling and proper aftercare:
- Keratin Bond: 2–4 months
- Nano Ring, Micro Ring, Tape-In, Weft: ~ 2 months each
- Clip-In: reusable 6–12 months

The hair itself can be reused for 6–9 months across multiple repositionings.

### Will hair extensions damage my natural hair?
Depends on the method and your hair strength:
- Keratin Bond: higher risk if your hair isn't strong enough
- Nano Ring: less damaging than keratin bond
- Tape-In: low damage while worn; risk is during incorrect removal
- Weft: very low damage — only 3–5 horizontal lines, not all over
- Micro Ring: minimal damage with trained application/removal
- Clip-In: zero damage (temporary)

### When can I wash my hair after installation?
Always wait at least 48 hours before the first wash. Bonds need time to cure
and rings/tapes need to settle. After 48 hours: sulfate-free shampoo for
keratin and tape-in; gentle washing around the attachment line for rings and
wefts; clip-ins only when visibly soiled. We send a personalised aftercare
guide after every appointment.

### Which method is right for me?
Method selection depends mostly on natural hair density:
- Fine hair → Keratin Bond (lightweight, blends without weight)
- Medium-to-thick hair → Tape-In, Weft, or Nano Ring (more volume capacity)
- Temporary use → Clip-In (no commitment)

### How do I book?
Send a photo of your natural hair to WhatsApp +62 821-4691-8725. We confirm
the method, colour match, and full price before you come in.
